_notice: Technology profiles: which discovery range and which link model a marketplace experiment uses. Reliability models declare their own label range separately; a mismatch is recorded, never silently ignored.

nr_sidelink_u2n_relay.description: NR sidelink UE-to-Network relay (3GPP Rel-17, TR 38.836 / TS 23.304). PUE = U2N relay UE, CUE = U2N remote UE, PUE-CUE hop = PC5 sidelink, PUE Internet = cellular Uu backhaul, MEC = marketplace coordinator.
nr_sidelink_u2n_relay.device_assumptions: Vehicle-mounted UEs with NR sidelink (PC5) and U2N relay capability. NOT assumed to be ordinary smartphones; consumer handsets generally do not expose sidelink relay.
nr_sidelink_u2n_relay.network_assumptions: In-coverage operation; gNB-scheduled sidelink resources (mode 1); operator authorises relay and remote UEs; MEC coordinates matching and pricing.

abstract_sidelink.description: Provisional technology-agnostic profile used in Phase 2 (kept for comparison).
